expected_source: 515 is 0x0203: the service routine ran exactly three times and the only pending bit it ever saw was RCFP, bit 1 of EIPR. Both halves are hand-derived from SPRUE48 Table 10 - nothing drives the transmit section, so only the receive clock can fail - and from the interrupt rule in SPRU871K 7.4.2, which is why clearing the pending bit in the routine is what allows the next failure to be announced
